name: rdf-shacl-to-spanner-graph
description: Gemini CLI extension to translate RDF/SHACL to Cloud Spanner Graph DDL

settings.name: Spanner Project ID
settings.description: The Google Cloud Project ID to target.

settings.name: Remote Spanner MCP Server URL
settings.description: SSE URL of the remote Spanner MCP Server (e.g. http://localhost:8000/sse).

settings.name: Local Spanner MCP Command
settings.description: Local stdio command to run a Spanner MCP Server (e.g. python3 path/to/server.py).

settings.name: Spanner MCP Tool Name
settings.description: The specific tool name to execute DDL on Spanner. Leave blank for auto-discovery.
